## D — Accuracy and source flags: Vehicle inspection, seating and mirrors

Retain cold-tire pressure checks, the exact penny-test finding, front and rear light-transmission limits with the stated rear enforcement tolerance, film boundary wording, steering-wheel clearance and mirror adjustment positions. [A23] [A24] [A25]
The cover lacks extracted text and is not visually cleared. The edition observation is on the back matter; no image-only content was converted into a learner fact.
